guide.title: Sonya's Overview
guide.text:
Sonya is an aggressive but durable Bruiser with
a fair amount of self-sustain and
capable of dealing a high amount of damage from melee distance,
making her one of the best Offlaners
in the game when played correctly.

guide.title: Sonya's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
High waveclear
Great self-sustain
High single-target damage
Great at capturing Mercenary Camps
Weaknesses
Susceptible to being kited
No options to deal damage from range
Excessively reliant on hitting Ancient Spear
Whirlwind can be easily interrupted
Low mobility

guide.title: Sonya's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Sonya synergizes with
When going for Leap as Heroic Ability,
having a powerful follow-up is crucial.
As such, she does better when paired with Heroes who can
dive together with her and/or deal a lot
of burst damage on the same target.
When going for Wrath of the Berserker
as Heroic Ability, survival means damage and damage means survival.
As a consequence, she works well with any Hero that can keep her
alive for longer with healing, damage mitigation effects, added
mobility, or who can reliably
crowd control enemy Heroes.
Sonya is countered by
Sonya can be easily punished after engaging because she relies on the
self-sustain from her Abilities and Talents. For this reason,
Heroes that have crowd control and/or burst damage
in their kit are a respectable threat for her.
Wrath of the Berserker only reduces the duration
of Stun, Root, and Slow
effects. As such, Heroes with access to Silence effects
(including Taunt and Fear)
are better for crowd controlling her.

guide.title: Sonya's Maps
guide.text:
Sonya's stronger maps
Sonya's average maps
Sonya's weaker maps
As a solid Offlaner capable of double soaking
and clear Mercenary Camps with ease, Sonya can find a place on all Maps. She is, however, particularly
effective on those Maps that feature several Mercenary Camps (for example Garden of Terror).
Due to being relatively weak to ganks, Sonya struggles on Maps
where it is easier to gank the enemy Offlaner
(notably Towers of Doom).

guide.title: Sonya's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Try and keep your Fury full before impending engagements. Note that it does not decay over time.
When laning, you can tank enemy Minions to generate Fury and keep allied Minions healthy.
Ancient Spear is great for generating Fury and should be often used on non-Heroes for doing so.
To maximize sustain damage and Fury's Movement Speed uptime, do this: cast 1 Seismic Slam, execute 2 Basic Attacks, repeat.
When possible, Whirlwind is best used on multiple targets. Heroes give more self-healing.
Try to constantly generate Fury during Wrath of the Berserker to extend its duration.
Sonya can use Wrath of the Berserker to take down enemy Structures when uncontested.
Shot Of Fury at Level 4 can be used to extend Wrath of the Berserker's duration by 5 seconds.
Avoid using Nerves of Steel at Level 16 and Ignore Pain at Level 20 at the same time.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Sonya's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Thanks to her survivability and waveclear,
Sonya is a solid Offlaner that
can contribute with a huge amount of damage during team fights.
She is also good at double soaking when needed.
Sonya excels in prolonged battles or split-pushing
when having Wrath of the Berserker as Heroic Ability
and does great in short fights or ganks when having
Leap as Heroic Ability.

abilities.title: Sonya's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Try and keep your Fury full before impending engagements. Note that it does not decay over time.
When laning, you can tank enemy Minions to generate Fury and keep allied Minions healthy.
Ancient Spear is great for generating Fury and should be often used on non-Heroes for doing so.
To maximize sustain damage and Fury's Movement Speed uptime, do this: cast 1 Seismic Slam, execute 2 Basic Attacks, repeat.
When possible, Whirlwind is best used on multiple targets. Heroes give more self-healing.
Try to constantly generate Fury during Wrath of the Berserker to extend its duration.
Sonya can use Wrath of the Berserker to take down enemy Structures when uncontested.
Shot Of Fury at Level 4 can be used to extend Wrath of the Berserker's duration by 5 seconds.
Avoid using Nerves of Steel at Level 16 and Ignore Pain at Level 20 at the same time.

abilities.title: Fury
abilities.text:
Fury
(D)
Sonya
Passive
Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.
Sonya uses Fury instead of Mana. Seismic Slam
costs 25 Fury, Whirlwind costs 40 Fury, and every other
Basic or Heroic Ability costs no Fury. In addition to that, whenever you use a Basic or Heroic Ability,
Sonya gains a small but nonetheless useful amount of Movement Speed for a few seconds.
Contrary to Mana on other Heroes, Fury does not regenerate over time. Sonya has to generate it:
Basic Attacks generate 6 Fury, each instance of damage taken generates 2 Fury,
Ancient Spear generates 40 Fury, and
activating Shot Of Fury at Level 4 gives 50 Fury.
The maximum amount of Fury that can be stored is 100.
As a resource, Fury is not particularly difficult to manage, though it is an
integral part of Sonya's playstyle. A simple rule of thumb is to not spend it
when you may not be able to regenerate it before engaging in any kind of player
combat, for which you always want your Fury bar to be full or nearly so.
Do not waste Ancient Spear's cooldown to generate
Fury when almost full because you may need it shortly after for damage
or mobility.
The small Movement Speed bonus that Sonya gets when using a Basic or
Heroic Ability is quite useful to outmanoeuvre, chase,
or escape from many less-mobile Heroes. Movement Speed is helpful for
increasing your Basic Attack uptime as well, granted that
you maintain the effect by using an Ability at least once every 4 seconds.

abilities.title: Ancient Spear
abilities.text:
Ancient Spear
(Q)
Sonya
Cooldown: 13 seconds
Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173 (+4% per level) damage and briefly stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.
Ancient Spear is a Basic Ability with many important functions.
Besides dealing a large amount of damage, the Ability acts as Sonya's
main gap-closer, interrupt tool,
and Fury generator. If you pick Mystical Spear at Level 13,
you can also use it as a mobility tool when not hitting
an enemy, even across impassable terrain.
Failing to hit an enemy with Ancient Spear during a team fight can leave
you Fury-starved for an extended period of time, especially if you do not have
Shot Of Fury at Level 4 as an alternative way to generate Fury,
as you will then have to rely on Basic Attacks to generate enough Fury to use your other
Basic Abilities. If you have Wrath of the Berserker as Heroic Ability,
this will also cause its duration to be shorter.
For this reason, it is essential that you learn the Ability's range and
projectile speed so that you may reliably hit your intended target, even in high
stress situations. Do know that keen opponents who understand the importance of
the Ability may attempt to juke you to avoid being hit, at which point experience
and prediction skills will come into play.

abilities.title: Seismic Slam
abilities.text:
Seismic Slam
(W)
Sonya
Fury: 25
Cooldown: 1 seconds
Deals 176 (+4% per level) damage to the target enemy, and 44 (+4% per level) to enemies behind the target.
Seismic Slam is a point-and-click Basic Ability that can be used to deal
damage to a given enemy and a lower amount of damage
to any enemy unit behind them. With such a high
damage value on a very short cooldown, it is one of the best sustain damage
Abilities in the game, and is key to eliminating Heroes, Mercenaries, and
Structures alike. Due to its short range, it is important to remain near
your foes as much as possible, when it is safe to do so. Fury generation
has a similar level of importance as you will not be able to use
Seismic Slam without it.
Seismic Slam deals some damage to foes behind your initial target too.
This effect is typically not taken into account during team fights
as this limited damage is rarely worth the hassle of having to reposition yourself
but you should definitely play around it while laning
as it will contribute to your waveclear.
Sonya's fast Attack Speed
makes it possible to land 2 Basic Attacks between each Seismic Slam.
By casting Seismic Slam every 2 Basic Attacks,
you will maximise your sustain damage and
promote Fury generation. By casting it on cooldown, you will maximize
your burst damage at the cost of Fury.

abilities.title: Whirlwind
abilities.text:
Whirlwind
(E)
Sonya
Fury: 40
Cooldown: 5 seconds
Deals 138 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.
Whirlwind is a channeled Ability that
can be used to deal damage and heal for a portion of the damage dealt,
even when moving. Sonya can pass through enemy units during its effect,
denying enemy Heroes the possibility to body block her.
The self-healing provided by Whirlwind allows Sonya to self-sustain
while laning and increases her survivability in team fights,
especially when she is able to hit multiple enemy Heroes with it
because the self-healing that comes from damaging them is increased.
Whirlwind can also be situationally useful for
both chasing and escaping. Since it does not have a casting animation, unlike
Ancient Spear and Seismic Slam, you can instantly benefit from
the Movement Speed increase provided by Fury without having to stop
moving.
Whirlwind is notably powerful against team compositions that lack reliable
means of interrupting it. Hitting several Heroes at
once can yield an impressive amount of healing, though one should see to first
and foremost remain in a safe position. Considering that Whirlwind's
healing depends on the amount of damage done with it, effects that increase
Sonya's Spell Damage or increase the damage taken by enemies
(for example Armor reduction) will
effectively cause Whirlwind to heal more.

abilities.title: Leap
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Leap
(R)
Sonya
Heroic
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.
Leap is a strong Heroic Ability that allows Sonya to become
Unstoppable and jump towards a target location.
Upon impact, all enemies take damage and are Stunned,
interrupting any channel
in progress (such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).
Leap can be used either as a gap-closer or as
an escape, to survive unexpected ganks
or to counter delayed crowd-control
effects (notably Temporal Loop by Chromie).
During team fights, Leap is a powerful engage
which can enable several other Abilities that require a
setup of some sort to be effective
(for example Ring of Frost by Jaina).
When using Leap on moving enemy Heroes, you should take into account
their Movement Speed and Sonya's travel time during Leap's animation,
otherwise you will end up missing the target. Be aware of possible
jukes as well.

abilities.title: Wrath of the Berserker
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Wrath of the Berserker
(R)
Sonya
Heroic
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.
Wrath of the Berserker is a strong Heroic Ability which greatly empowers
the damage that Sonya deals with Basic Attacks and Abilities
and reduces the duration of most crowd control effects:
Stuns (including Sleeps),
Roots, and Slows.
The effect lasts 15 seconds, extended by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.
Wrath of the Berserker temporarily turns Sonya into a force to be reckoned
with, even for the toughest of Tanks
and Bruisers, as it greatly increases Sonya's damage. While active,
Sonya becomes so powerful that Heroes without mobility
and lack of peeling will not be able to survive.
The reduced duration of most crowd control effects
is quite useful when fighting against Heroes who have access to
Stuns (including Sleeps),
Roots, and Slows. These are
all effects that can be used for peeling,
thus not allowing Sonya to deal damage on the desired target.
Outside of general player combat, Wrath of the Berserker is useful for very
quickly claiming Mercenary Camps, waveclearing, or destroying
Structures. Due to its relatively short cooldown and potentially high uptime
with correct Fury management, one should not shy away from
using the Ability outside of team fights as well. This is typically achieved
by aggressively delivering Basic Attacks, using Ancient Spear,
and activating Shot Of Fury at Level 4 before
Wrath of the Berserker expires.

If you look at the buff tracker in the bottom-left corner,

Genji, Kharazim, Lúcio, Tassadar, Tracer,
and Tychus). Heroes with Clones (for example Nova) can consume them faster
too, however, it is generally not a problem because their AI will not always target you.

When directly targeting an enemy Hero with Seismic Slam,
the splash damage is increased by 500%. When directly targeting an enemy non-Hero,
the splash damage is increased by 250% and the splash length is extended by 66%.
The damage done to the main target is not increased.
If you plan to pick Leap as Heroic Ability, even if
Shot Of Fury increases your burst damage
on the main target, you should heavily prefer Shattered Ground
because it increases your waveclear, allowing you to
clear Minions and rotate faster.
?
Hurricane
(Level 4)
Sonya
Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.
Hurricane is a good Talent that reduces
Whirlwind's cooldown and turns it into
a Slow and Root removal.
The cooldown reduction provided is great in conjunction with
Life Funnel at Level 7 as it allows you
to get even more healing from Whirlwind.
The ability to remove some types of crowd control
effects from Sonya right before Whirlwind goes off
helps her to reposition for dealing damage with it or to escape from danger.
✔
Shot Of Fury
(Level 4)
Sonya
Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.
Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.
Shot Of Fury is a strong Talent that increases
Sonya's Attack Damage after casting Seismic Slam
and can be activated to generate 50 Fury when needed.
We find this Talent quite useful as, by generating Fury on activation,
it allows you to extend Wrath of the Berserker's duration
when needed, in addition to Ancient Spear.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Sonya
talent_pages.text:
?
Poisoned Spear
(Level 7)
Sonya
Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.
Poisoned Spear is a good Talent that adds a
potent damage-over-time effect to
Ancient Spear, effectively doubling its damage
against all kinds of enemies.
Even if it takes a total of 6 seconds, Poisoned Spear
is still the best burst damage option in this Tier,
making it an interesting option when planning to pick Leap
as Heroic Ability.
When playing against Heroes with Stealth,
the damage-over-time effect is nice
to have as it will either break Stealth or prevent them from entering
Stealth in the first place as they know it will break.
?
Life Funnel
(Level 7)
Sonya
Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.
Life Funnel is a good Talent that increases
Whirlwind's healing from 25% to 35% of damage dealt.
The effectiveness of this Talent goes up when Sonya is able to constantly
hit multiple enemies during Whirlwind.
Thanks to the additional self-sustain provided,
this effect helps Sonya stay healthy while laning,
while capturing Mercenary Camps, and in team fights.
Avoid picking this Talent when playing against Heroes who can
easily interrupt Whirlwind.
If they pay attention to it, Whirlwind's effectiveness
in team fights will be drastically reduced, so you will get little to no value
from Life Funnel in these situations.
✔
Battle Rage
(Level 7)
Sonya
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 30 seconds
Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.
Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.
Battle Rage is a strong Talent which passively increases
Sonya's damage to Mercenaries and can be activated to heal Sonya for 10% of her
maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges.
When activated, it goes on a 5-second cooldown. You can activate it while
channeling Whirlwind.
We generally recommend this Talent because it increases your
self-sustain, can occasionally be helpful
against burst damage, and empowers your damage
against neutral and enemy Mercenaries.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Sonya
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
?
Leap
(Level 10)
Sonya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.
Leap is a strong Heroic Ability that allows Sonya to become
Unstoppable and jump towards a target location.
Upon impact, all enemies take damage and are Stunned,
interrupting any channel
in progress (such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).
We recommend picking Leap when
your team needs an additional engage tool
or desperately needs interrupt for a powerful
channeled Heroic Ability. You can use it to
burst someone down, to dive,
or to execute a wombo combo.
✔
Wrath of the Berserker
(Level 10)
Sonya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.
Wrath of the Berserker is a strong Heroic Ability which greatly empowers
the damage that Sonya deals with Basic Attacks and Abilities
and reduces the duration of most crowd control effects:
Stuns (including Sleeps),
Roots, and Slows.
The effect lasts 15 seconds, extended by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.
We recommend picking Wrath of the Berserker when
your team needs more damage and/or when you feel like you can get value
from split-pushing on bigger Maps.
You can also use it to capture and/or defend Mercenary Camps faster,
thus increasing your impact at macro level.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Sonya
talent_pages.text:
?
Mystical Spear
(Level 13)
Sonya
Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.
Mystical Spear is a situational Talent that
turns Ancient Spear into an unconditional
mobility tool. When you do not hit
an enemy with Ancient Spear, Sonya will still
dash forward and Ancient Spear's cooldown
will be reduced by 5 seconds.
The extra mobility provided by this Talent
can be useful to escape when in danger. You can even use it to escape or
chase over impassable terrain,
including player-created one (for example Force Wall by Tassadar).
✘
Ruthless
(Level 13)
Sonya
Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.
Ruthless is a decent Talent that empowers
Whirlwind's damage when hitting enemy Heroes
below 50% maximum Health. Note that the extra damage dealt this way
does NOT increase Whirlwind's healing.
We find this Talent not good enough to compete with No Escape
because bonus Movement Speed provided by No Escape will help you stick
on the target, indirectly increasing your damage, and because Whirlwind
is primarily being used for self-sustain. If you want to deal
more damage, it is better to just use Seismic Slam instead.
✔
No Escape
(Level 13)
Sonya
Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.
No Escape is a strong Talent that further increases
Sonya's Movement Speed bonus from Fury when using
a Basic or Heroic Ability, helping you to stick on the target.
We heavily recommend picking this Talent because the additional
Movement Speed it provides can be useful in various ways:
dodging, repositioning in team fights,
chasing, and escaping.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Sonya
talent_pages.text:
✔
Giant Slammer
(Level 16)
Sonya
Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.
Giant Slammer is a strong Talent that causes
Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam to deal more
damage in the form of percent-based damage
and heal Sonya for a portion of the damage dealt this way.
If you have Leap as Heroic Ability,
you must pick this Talent to increase your burst
damage. If you have Wrath of the Berserker,
you can be more flexible but this Talent is still the best
option to increase your burst and sustain damage as well.
Since it gives way more value when you can constantly hit
enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam,
this Talent is not good for Whirlwind Build as you will spend most of your
time channeling Whirlwind.
?
Rampage
(Level 16)
Sonya
Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.
Rampage is a decent Talent that increases
Sonya's Attack Damage and causes Basic Attacks to reduce
Ancient Spear's cooldown.
The cooldown reduction provided by this Talent allows you
to generate more Fury if you manage
to hit enemies with Ancient Spear,
makes missing Ancient Spear less
punishing, and has synergy with Poisoned Spear
at Level 7 as you will be able to cast Ancient Spear
more often.
Since it gives way more value when you can constantly hit
enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks,
this Talent is not good for Whirlwind Build as you will spend most of your
time channeling Whirlwind.
?
Nerves of Steel
(Level 16)
Sonya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.
Nerves of Steel is a situational Talent that, once per fight,
can be activated to gain a powerful Shield for a few seconds. You can activate it while
channeling Whirlwind.
We find this Talent useful when playing against team composition
who can deal a lot of burst damage.
Just make sure to activate it before you take too much damage and before
you get hit by enemy crowd control effects.
That said, Ignore Pain at Level 20 is usually enough.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Sonya
talent_pages.text:
?
Arreat Crater
(Level 20)
Sonya
Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds. Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.
Arreat Crater is a situational Talent that
reduces Leap's cooldown and causes it to
leave a circle of impassable terrain
around Sonya upon landing, blocking Sonya and nearby enemies inside it.
The impassable terrain it creates can be used to
block enemy Heroes in a narrow area, to prevent enemy Heroes from moving from a side
of the battlefield to another during a team fight, or to stop their retreat.
Be careful not to block your teammates with it!
The cooldown reduction may occasionally help you cast Leap
twice in a single team fight or use it for two consecutive team fights
with low downtime between them. For example, you could gank
someone and then have it back for the next team fight.
?
Striding Giant
(Level 20)
Sonya
Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.
Striding Giant is a decent Talent that, while
Wrath of the Berserker is active, passively increases Sonya's
maximum Health and gives access to an Active called Striding Giant. Once every
30 seconds, Striding Giant can be activated to make Sonya
Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
The ability to become Unstoppable can be
useful in preventing Whirlwind from being interrupted and
at countering Heroes who rely on crowd-control for kills
(notably Chromie with Temporal Loop). Since Striding Giant
cannot be activated when Wrath of the Berserker is not active,
you will also need Wrath of the Berserker's cooldown to be available.
?
Composite Spear
(Level 20)
Sonya
Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.
Composite Spear is a good Talent that increases
Ancient Spear's range by a considerable amount
and, when hitting an enemy Hero, increases Sonya's survivability
by granting her Armor for a few seconds.
The range increase provided by Composite Spear can be useful against
range-heavy team compositions that tend to kite you to death before
you can deal any significant damage.
The bonus Armor provided is also notable for prolonged team fights,
especially if you combine this Talent with Rampage at Level 16 for
a higher uptime, but cannot compete with Ignore Pain
when you need more protection from burst damage.
✔
Ignore Pain
(Level 20)
Sonya
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.
Ignore Pain is a strong Talent that can be activated to gain
a huge amount of Armor for a few seconds. You can activate it while
channeling Whirlwind.
We recommend picking this Talent in most games because it drastically increases
your survivability in late-game team fights, where it is
extremely important to not die too quickly and without getting any kills.
We find this Talent useful when playing against team composition
who can deal a lot of burst damage.
Just make sure to activate it before you take too much damage and before
you get hit by enemy crowd control effects.
If you also have Nerves of Steel at Level 16,
wait for one defensive effect to end before using the other one.
